--------------------------------------------------------------------------
Why the dump is silent on both questions.

`dxa -dumpreflection` drives ID3D12ShaderReflection through DXC's
own D3DReflectionDumper. An absent field in its output therefore
means one of two very different things, and only reading the dumper
tells you which: the accessor returned nothing, or the dumper never
called it. Here it is the second, for both halves of the issue.

$ grep -n ThreadGroup|Topology|ShaderKind::Mesh <repo>\lib\DxilContainer\D3DReflectionDumper.cpp
   70:   case (UINT)hlsl::DXIL::ShaderKind::Mesh:
  164:     DumpEnum("GSOutputTopology", Desc.GSOutputTopology);
  180:   if (ShaderKind == hlsl::DXIL::ShaderKind::Mesh) {
[3 matching lines]

GetThreadGroupSize call sites in D3DReflectionDumper.cpp: 0

So: the dumper never calls GetThreadGroupSize at all, and prints
GSOutputTopology only inside its `ShaderKind == Geometry` branch.
Its Mesh branch prints one line, about PatchConstantParameters.
That is why #4619 needs refl4619.cpp, which calls the accessors the
reporter named, directly.
